Elena / Marcus —

Looping in the security team for clarity on evidence and acceptance gates. A few concrete notes and what we'll provide:

What Redwood can provide (artifacts):
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted) + control mapping spreadsheet (SOC2->SIG items).
- SIG/CAIQ answers spreadsheet (we will provide a scoped file focused on data protection, tokenization, and network boundary controls).
- Evidence index (CSV) listing artifact name, owner, delivery ETA.

Data residency & retention specifics (short):
- Hosted (multi-tenant): regional hosting available (us/eu). We provide region-level data localization for at-rest storage and backups, but some control plane metadata may replicate for operational safety. Default retention: 90 days for request logs and KV cache; optional 365 days for audit logs with a contractual addendum and pricing uplift.
- Private (single-tenant/VPC): full data residency guarantees within the customer region, separate tenancy, and standard retention windows configurable per contract.

Acceptance / gating criteria we propose (security_compliance lens):
- SOC2: Receipt and review of Type II report + signed attestation that controls cover the proposed integration scope.
- SIG: Completed answers for the scoped SIG subset and no outstanding high-severity gaps (mediums require mitigation plan).
- DPA: Executed DPA with agreed retention windows and subprocessor list.
- Evidence: All critical artifacts uploaded to shared drive and indexed.

Proposed milestone calendar (we can adjust):
- Evidence intake due: 2027-07-15
- Security review complete: 2027-07-22
- DPA final sign: 2027-07-29
- Provisioning & pilot kickoff: 2027-08-10
- Pilot acceptance: 2027-08-20

Attachment stub: evidence-index.csv (CSV) — we'll push a tracked file into the Drive folder linked below once you confirm scope.

Quick question for procurement: Do you have a hard gating date for DPA signature? Procurement calendars sometimes shift a day; if the DPA is keyed into legal's July tranche we can prioritize.

Thanks,
